messages:
sam: Quick follow-up on the kernel selection / attention-opt RFC. Need to lock down runtime rollout controls before we flip opt_v2 to default. Specifically: per-model flags, canary pct, fallback kernel mapping, and emergency kill-switch. RFC doc: https://redwood.infra/rfcs/attention-optim-2026 — please confirm owners.

liam: +1. I can own the per-model flag bits and the per-request kernel selector. Plan: feature flag `kernel_selector.per_model` with model->kernel regex map. Start with a 10% canary on prod. question: do we want region-scoped canaries or customer-tier scoping?

rachel: i'd prefer customer-tier scoping first (dev/staging/prod) — region-scoped adds cache/locality complexity. i'll own telemetry/dashboard and alerts for the canary.

jessica: fallback policy proposal: prefer same-arch optimized kernel, then quantized variant, then legacy safe kernel. If KV cache layout mismatch, fallback to `safe_v1` and capture a sample (scrub PII). Tag logs with `kernel.fallback_reason`.

sam: also want a global kill-switch to force route-to-safe for rapid mitigation. Example runtime flag: `runtime.kernel.force_fallback=true` toggles immediate fallback and bypasses canary.

liam: rough config snippet for the flag service (proto-y):
```
flags:
  kernel_selector.per_model: |
    - match: ".*redwood-13b.*"
      kernel: "opt_v2"
    - match: ".*gpt-open.*"
      kernel: "safe_v1"
  rollout:
    canary_pct: 10
    scope: "customer_tier"  # dev, staging, prod
  fallback.policy: "same_arch->quantized->safe_v1"
  runtime.kernel.force_fallback: false
```

liam: implementation notes: will expose `--kernel-override=<kernel>` at runtime for troubleshooting and add a per-request header `X-Kernel-Reason` for auditing.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started for opt_v2 kernel (10%) on cluster-6 at 1937654300.

rachel: dashboard draft: https://dashboards.redwood.net/d/xyz/kernel-rollout?org=redwood — i'll add panels for 99p latency, token throughput, error-rate, and embedding-quality-regression (model-specific eval probes). will set alerts: latency > baseline+20% OR error rate > 0.5% triggers page.

jessica: +1 on synthetic probes — we'll run a small suite every 5m during canary and log diffs. also add a regression tag that ties to prompt-set ids.

sam: action items: @liam implement the flag + per-model gating (PR + unit tests), @rachel dashboard + alerting, @jessica implement fallback logging + synthetic probes, @sam will update the RFC tracking doc with rollout timeline and post-rollout eval checklist. reconvene tomorrow 10:00am in #eng-runtime for status. :thumbsup:

rachel: ack, i'll have a working dashboard link before the meeting. :eyes:

liam: ack, starting implementation branch now. tagging the RFC issue: https://redwood.infra/rfcs/attention-optim-2026#rollout-controls

jessica: adding the fallback reason enum to the api: `CACHE_MISMATCH`, `KERNEL_ERROR`, `SAFETY_THRESHOLD`, `MANUAL_OVERRIDE`. will push a tiny schema PR.

sam: thanks all — try to keep canary telemetry public in the dashboard so support/solutions can monitor. if anything spikes, flip `runtime.kernel.force_fallback=true` and ping #oncall.

deploy-bot: note: if kill-switch is toggled, traffic will be routed to `safe_v1` and canary will be paused automatically.

sam: sounds good. closing the loop here — see you tomorrow.
